game.name: Project Gotham Racing 3 (Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)(Rev 3)
game.desc: Project Gotham Racing 3 is a racing game for Xbox 360. Most of the races will have a specific goal, such as following a path set by cones placed in pairs on the track, reaching a certain speed by passing a radar, or overtaking a specific number of competitors in a given time.
